sourceText:
Salt Baked Prime Rib Roast
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Tuesday, December 4, 2012 - 4:35pm

Ingredients




4 pound bone-in prime rib roast
2 cups coarse kosher salt (important that it is coarse, not fine!)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 210 degrees F 2 Cover the bottom of a roasting pan with a thin layer of coarse kosher salt. Place the roast, bone side down, on the salt and season well with freshly ground black pepper. 3 Cover roast with remaining salt. Don't worry if the entire roast is not completely covered. 4 Roast in preheated oven for 4 hours, or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 145 degrees F. 5 Remove from oven and let rest for 30 minutes to allow juices to set. Remove roast from salt; carve and serve.

Comments:
Anne

4? Hours I presume?
Sheri Wetherell

Yes, 4 hours. Sorry I was remiss in adding that! Thanks for the catch :) Happy holidays!
